job.title: Regional Sales Manager - Medical
job.description:

  • Multi-national, US company, strong clinical focus with quality healthcare products, very customer-centric with solid focus on excellent patient outcomes.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
  • At this organisation, their culture is critical to enabling their people to be the best they can be.
  • It’s very important that all their employees are able to focus on making an impact on the world and feel empowered to bring innovation to their work.

  • Develop yourself through inspiring work by leading important projects, working with diverse, talented people and finding endless opportunities to develop your skills – while enjoying access to many perks, programs and resources.
THE JOB - ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS PERFORMED
  • This VIC/TAS Regional Sales Manager position will manage 3 Territory Managers and a Clinical Specialist and will be responsible for exceeding sales targets.

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE LEADING
  • We are looking for a commercially astute Financial Controller to join this senior leadership team of an established organisation.
  • This is a broad leadership role with responsibility for the financial performance, governance and commercial stewardship of the business, while also contributing to the development and execution of broader organisational strategy.
  • Working closely with senior leaders, this position will provide high-level financial insight, challenge and guidance to support sustainable growth, investment decisions and overall business performance.
  • This role will support strategic planning, commercial decision making and business growth and provide meaningful financial analysis and advice to assess opportunities, investments, risks and operational performance.
  • Leading the annual budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes, you will monitor financial performance against agreed targets and provide regular reporting to senior leadership.
  • You will work closely with business leaders to maintain strong cost management disciplines and ensure expenditure is aligned with organisational priorities, while ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting to local, regional and group stakeholders.
  • Maintaining strong financial controls, governance frameworks and administrative processes is a part of this role along with overseeing statutory reporting requirements and ensuring compliance with relevant accounting, taxation and regulatory obligations.
  • You will manage relationships with external auditors and coordinate the annual audit process and oversee corporate taxation requirements, including GST, FBT, income tax and other relevant statutory obligations.
  • You will provide oversight of treasury, cash flow and broader financial risk management activities and support the development and evaluation of operational plans, capital expenditure proposals and business investment initiatives.
YOU WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING TO BE SUCCESSFUL
  • A minimum of 7 years corporate finance experience, including substantial responsibility for leading a finance function within a sizeable, commercially focused organisation.
  • Experience operating in a complex business environment with meaningful scale, ideally within an organisation generating significant annual revenue.
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in accounting, finance, commerce or a related discipline, with CPA, CA or equivalent professional accreditation.
  • Strong financial systems capability, with experience using enterprise-level ERP platforms such as SAP and confidence across the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Demonstrated success in leading, developing and motivating teams, with the ability to create alignment, accountability and a strong sense of shared purpose.
  • The ability to move comfortably between high-level strategic thinking and detailed operational execution with strong commercial instincts and the confidence to contribute beyond the traditional finance remit.
  • A collaborative, energetic and self-directed working style, supported by strong relationship-building, communication and influencing skills.
  • The maturity and interpersonal capability to work effectively with senior executives, operational leaders and cross-functional teams.

  • Strong English communication, written and verbal, with full Australian working rights and ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams, with work experience in Australia.
